system.description:
Weapon Kit — Close-range fire that punishes Smoldering foes, with blast, air and napalm options.

Flame Jet (basic) — 1 Action. Reach 4, Damage: 1d8 Fire. Double damage if the target is Smoldering. Ignores armor. On crit: apply Smoldering.

Toolbelt (2 Actions):

  • Flame Blast. Cone 3, Damage: 2d8 Fire. On hit: inflict Smoldering. Ignores armor.
  • Air Blast. Reach 4, Damage: 3d8 Fire. On a failed STR save, Large and smaller targets are pushed back INT spaces. Can't miss Smoldering targets, and Smoldering targets automatically fail.
  • Napalm. Reach 4, Wall 4. Lasts 1 minute or until dispersed. Targets that start or end a turn adjacent to it or enter an adjacent space take KEY Fire damage. Ignores armor.

High Levels: +5 damage every 5 levels (Flame Jet, Flame Blast, Air Blast). +2 damage every 5 levels (Napalm).

[A] Grants the Flamethrower item (basic ability, 1 Action, no scrap) and one feature per Toolbelt option (2 Actions, 1 Toolbelt scrap each, spent natively). Scraps are tracked on the sheet (click the counter to correct mistakes).

[A] High-level damage/healing bonuses are built into the formulas.

[M] Weapon Kits count as weapons for swapping and stowing.
